summary: All findings in the review file are now closed except two items the reviewer or implementer already flagged as needing another owner. When I picked this up, an earlier fix engineer (no progress file) had already fixed the RB modifier, pad-capture gestures, scent-view yield, 200 ms reduced-motion crossfade, player-pad picking, hold-scaled View tap and the fail-on-failure e2e, and the unit tests were green. I audited each finding against the tree and then did the remaining work. (1) Flash reduction now reaches the lightning renderer. (2) The e2e dismiss-hint check is now a strict assertion with a real hint on screen and a real possessed ant. (3) The nav controller shares the View-tap constant with toolsPad instead of a duplicate. Typecheck is clean and 165 unit tests pass. Every e2e section passed across three harness runs; one chain run was cut off by the harness script timeout under load (about 10), not by a failure.
verification: npm run typecheck: no errors at all (not just my paths).

npx vitest run src/input src/ui/nav src/game/accessibility src/content/text/controls.test.ts src/ui/panels/wiring src/render/world/weather: 16 files, 165 tests pass. This includes the reviewer's gamepadA11y.verify, nav.verify and accessibility.verify tests, now green, and the opening.test.ts the earlier engineer added.

Harness run 1 (test-output/a11y-fix, full a11y.mjs): sections G, B, B2, C, C2, D and E pass (31 recorded checks). The 1500 s script timeout hit during E2 (C2 alone took 635 s under load average about 10), so E2 and F did not finish in this run.
Harness run 2 (A11Y_SECTIONS=E2,F, test-output/a11y-fix2): E2 and F pass, ok:true, errors:[]. F is the focus-order audit with 0 issues.
Harness run 3 (A11Y_SECTIONS=G,B,C-, test-output/a11y-fix4): G, B and B2 passed, then the script timeout hit in C under load about 11, which is a harness timeout and not a check failure.

Harness run 4 (A11Y_SECTIONS=C-, test-output/a11y-fix5): C passes with the strict dismiss-hint check. The hint-cycle card was on screen, RB + View dismissed it, and the possessed ant 9858 was unchanged. The panel shortcuts (Colony orders, Roster, Nest overview, Colony health, Journal and others) left the possessed ant unchanged. LB + D-pad left changed speed without touching the scent view. LB + D-pad up paused in the possess, observer and colony views.

Screenshots looked at: test-output/a11y-fix/C-glyph-hud-hidden-xbox.png (Xbox glyph chip 'LB + D-pad down'), D-rebind-conflict.png (conflict message with Swap, Unbind other and Cancel), C2-photo-mode-pad.png (photo panel with pad glyph legend, no black frame).
No harness process of mine is left running. The play.mjs process currently running (species=camponotus) belongs to another engineer.

acceptance.criterion: Finding 1: RB is both possess-next and a modifier, so panel shortcuts also switched the ant
acceptance.evidence: possess-next is now a tap on RB (pTap, src/input/actions.ts:69). The reviewer's 5 RB tests pass, and e2e panels-by-pad asserts that the possessed ant is unchanged after each RB panel shortcut.

acceptance.criterion: Finding 2: pad rebinding drops tap/hold gestures, so conflicts go unreported
acceptance.evidence: src/input/bindings.ts collides() compares gestures. src/input/rebind.ts keeps the slot's default gesture when the captured button is the default one. The reviewer's 3 tests pass.

acceptance.criterion: Finding 3: LB + D-pad left also toggles the scent view
acceptance.evidence: ShortcutMatcher in src/ui/nav/shortcuts.ts yields to every live modified pad combination of the game. The reviewer's nav.verify test passes, and the e2e scent-by-pad check confirms speed changes while the scent view is left alone (lbLeftLeftItAlone:true).

acceptance.criterion: Finding 4: reduced-motion camera transition is 0.3 s, not a 200 ms crossfade
acceptance.evidence: CAM_REDUCED_CROSSFADE_S is 0.2 in src/render/camera/constants.ts (render-owned constant, changed by the earlier engineer). The accessibility.verify test passes and the e2e asserts <= 0.2. The task text says 'instant'; I followed GDD 08 2.4 / App E 18 by precedence.

acceptance.criterion: Finding 5: e2e cannot fail, and key checks only record
acceptance.evidence: The script throws at the end when result.failures is non-empty. The checks for timelapse-skip, opening-prompt-glyphs, dig-by-pad and panels-unchanged are real expects. I made dismiss-hint-by-pad strict this round: it resets the onboarding profile, possesses a worker, advances the clock, throws if no hint comes up, and asserts the hint is gone and the ant is unchanged.

acceptance.criterion: Finding 6: founding opening by pad not demonstrated
acceptance.evidence: Through the real opening phases on seed 1, the e2e demonstrates intro skip, walk, the first dig bite by holding X (phase 'dig') and time-lapse skip by holding A (skipping seen). The cell for the seal phase is a stand-in carve, so seal and lay by pad are not exercised through the real phases. Tend and the intro/tend/skip logic are covered by src/ui/nav/opening.test.ts.

acceptance.criterion: Finding 7: menu navigation reads the first connected pad, not the player pad
acceptance.evidence: The nav controller uses PlayerPadPicker and firstPad in src/input/padSource.ts. The reviewer's 'the pad the menus read is the one the player is using' test passes.

acceptance.criterion: Finding 8: flash reduction toggle does nothing
acceptance.evidence: Added optional FrameInfo.reducedFlash. WeatherRenderer uses the soft lightning brightening when reducedMotion or reducedFlash is set. Game.ts passes settings.accessibility.flashReduction. Typecheck and weather tests pass. There is no automated test of the GPU path (see notDone).

acceptance.criterion: Finding 9: nav View-tap threshold ignores the hold-duration setting
acceptance.evidence: controller.ts scales the tap limit by holdScale(), as the game's thresholds do. This round it also imports toolsPad's VIEW_TAP_MS instead of a duplicate constant. The nav tests that scale holds with the setting pass.

C2 passed in every run this round, including after the long chain: sticks moved the camera, LB + RS changed the focal length, X captured, B left. The earlier failure is not reproduced and its cause is still unknown. Its long duration (635 s) in run 1 coincided with load average about 10.

acceptance.criterion: Finding 11: edits outside owned paths (Game.ts, debugApi.ts, viewDirector.ts, schema.ts, two deleted files)
acceptance.evidence: Not a defect to fix. All are listed under notesForIntegrator for the integrator to confirm. My own edits outside the owned paths this round are additive and listed under contractChanges.

notDone: Seal and lay through the real founding phases by pad are still not exercised. The e2e uses a stand-in carve to reach the seal phase, per the earlier report. Tend is covered by a unit test only.
The sound-cue indicators toggle still has no effect. It needs the audio and render owners.

Flash reduction is wired, but no automated test covers WeatherRenderer's use of reducedFlash because it is a GPU path. GDD 08 App E 25 (no frame-to-frame exposure increase above +0.5 EV, at most 5 brightening events in 20 s of storm) needs the render or audio owner's check. With flash reduction on, lightning now uses the existing 2 s soft glow (peak LIGHTNING_REDUCED), not the GDD's 400 ms / +0.5 EV figure. Whether that meets App E 25 is unmeasured.
The photo-mode flake C2 (a failure in the long G,B,B2,C,C2 chain) is not reproduced and its cause is unknown.

The whole e2e takes over 25 minutes under load average 10 and exceeds the default 1500 s script timeout. Run it in subsets (A11Y_SECTIONS=G,B,C-,C2,D,E and A11Y_SECTIONS=E2,F) or on an idle machine. It has not run to completion in a single process in this session.

Unrelated: GDD 08 App E 21 says bindings persist in foundress.settings.v1, while GDD 01 5.7 (the owning chapter) says foundress.bindings.v1. The code follows GDD 01. I did not change anything for this.
contractChanges: src/render/index.ts: FrameInfo gains optional reducedFlash?: boolean (additive). Needs the render owner's confirmation.
notesForIntegrator: Edits outside my owned paths are listed in the review's finding 11 and in this report. Please confirm them. They are src/game/Game.ts (the a11y hook, plus reducedFlash this round), src/game/debug/debugApi.ts, src/game/views/viewDirector.ts (tremorScale), src/game/settings/schema.ts, src/render/camera/constants.ts (CAM_REDUCED_CROSSFADE_S 0.3 to 0.2, test-covered by handover.test.ts), src/render/index.ts and src/render/world/weather/WeatherRenderer.ts (the one-line reducedFlash read). The deleted src/ui/screens/gamepadNav.ts and src/ui/hud/drawerPad.ts were replaced by src/ui/nav.

tests/e2e/a11y.mjs fails the run, writing a11y-result.json first. Use A11Y_SECTIONS to run a subset, for example G,B,C-,C2,D,E and E2,F. 'C-' selects only the glyphs-and-panel-shortcuts section, so the 'C' prefix does not also pull in C2.

Flash reduction defaults to On, so with default settings storm lightning now uses the soft 2 s glow instead of the pulse. That is intended by GDD 08 (Flash reduction On is the default), but it changes the default storm look.
